document.description: Document name, e.g. the plan document or amendment name.

condition.description: For conditional: the condition that makes the field required, e.g. "if a QDRO exists". Null otherwise.

description.description: The dictionary definition verbiage for this field.

field.description: Data Dictionary Complete FIELD_NAME, e.g. RETSTAT. Any Input field — not only the template's 56.

note.description: Short note, e.g. the ambiguity, for R1 Interpretations of Note.

primarySource.description: Primary source of the field, e.g. "Census" or "Plan document".

reasonRequired.description: Why the field is required, e.g. "Benefit Calculation".

requiredFor.description: One key per participant group (same names as participantGroups); true when the field is required for that group.

status.description: present = required, source found. conditional = required only when the condition holds (state it in condition). notApplicable = the plan has no such provision. missing = not found yet, never guessed. ambiguous = two conflicting readings in one document.

match.description: The matched concept in the plan documentation, for the match-ranking table. The app recomputes the similarity score from definition + passage; the LLM proposes the match, the score ranks it.

concept.description: Name of the matched concept as it appears in the plan document.

passage.description: The matched plan-document verbiage (short, STE 100 minimal).

name.description: Source name, e.g. "Riverbend Manufacturing Pension Plan (restated 2020-01-01)".

description: The DEL JSON for one plan: header metadata, the sources list, and the data elements (fields) the plan requires, with provenance. v0.1.0 draft. The elements list is extensible: it accepts ANY Input field from the BCV Data Dictionary Complete, not only the template's 56. T001/T002 are template codes, not dictionary fields — they are allowed here with a note saying so.

elements.description: The data elements. One entry per field. The list is extensible to the full Input universe (220 Input + 51 Input|Calculated).

participantGroups.description: The Defined Groups of Participants — one column per group in the elements table. The template's example groups are "Pay Status Retirees/ Beneficiaries" and "Active/ Sep. Vested/ Non-Vested".

caseNumber.description: PBGC case number. Text — leading zeros are kept, never a number.

dotr.description: Date of Trusteeship, YYYY-MM-DD or null.

einPn.description: EIN / Plan Number, e.g. "12-3456789 / 001". Text, never a number.

narrative.description: Short narrative for the header. Keep it short.

planName.description: Plan name. The plan number goes with it in the template's Plan Name cell.

sourceDocuments.description: Source documents identified by name. Each one is a DEL source.

sources.description: The SOURCES LIST of the template: each source, its format, and whether it was used.
